title: a chart berth that claims a ticket is readable from every box
intention: Every chart-stage berth whose packet names a ticket is mirrored to CairnCommons/berths/chart/<name>, and chain_for_ticket over the default store reads that mirror too, so a hollow, verdict or chain read on a box other than the one that charted finds the chain.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akienasus for 3195b3b834bc, charted on akiendelllinux: the hollow refused with 'ticket 3195b3b834bc names no decompose berth', and sail.py verdict raised FileNotFoundError on ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/validate-20261112T205954-68e56653ee1c.json. chain._packet_index globs only <~/.cairn/devices>/*/packets, the local instance-space, so the orchestrator had to run both on the Dell. Sibling of d692ef650534, which mirrors sorted and intent berths to the commons at cast; chart berths are written later, by codemother's stage writers, so they need their own carry.
traces_to: Law 7 (a reader may not report as absent a chain that exists) and Law 1 (re-charting or hand-copying berths re-derives a settled chain).
how: (a) cairn/tools/chain/chain.py: carry_berth(path) reads the packet; if it carries a str 'ticket', write its bytes through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write to <roots()['CairnCommons']>/berths/chart/<basename>, verb 'chart', returning the destination (None when unclaimed or no commons). (b) _packet_index and _berths_token: when the root is the default BERTHS_ROOT, also index <commons>/berths/chart/*.json (stage from the filename prefix, as now) and fold that folder's mtime into the token; dedupe by basename, the local path winning. An explicit berths_root reads only itself. (c) Each stage writer calls chain.carry_berth(path) after its file is written: orient.write_packet, constrain.write_constrain, survey.write_survey, decompose.write_decompose, triage.write_triage, hypothesize.write_hypothesize, validate's writer (validate.py ~282) and verdict.write_verdict. (d) Red-first proof over a scratch store and a scratch commons.

clauses.claim: a claiming berth written by a stage writer is also present at <commons>/berths/chart/<name>, byte-identical
a berth whose packet names no ticket is not copied
chain_for_ticket over a default store that lacks the berth finds it through the commons mirror
a berth present in both the local store and the mirror is indexed once, at the local path

decisions.text: D1: carry_berth and the mirror-aware index in chain.py.

D2: each of the eight stage writers calls chain.carry_berth on the path it wrote. Each of the seven stage proofs (orient through validate) that allowlists its stage module's imports gains a "cairn.tools.chain.chain" entry in ALLOWED_IMPORTS, with a why citing e8fb6bcd23c5, following verdict's 2026-09-02 precedent (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py); a dynamic import is ruled out.
D3: the proof, one tooth per clause, over a scratch store and scratch commons.
